title: Lost Crypto to a Scam? Beware the 'Recovery Expert' Who Contacts You Next
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. Scam victims are often contacted again by fake 'recovery' services that ask for upfront fees, according to warnings from the FBI's IC3 and the CFTC. Real agencies do not charge to recover funds. AI-generated voice. Have you ever seen one of these messages? Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: SCAM WARNING
scenes.hook: SCAMMED ONCE? THE SECOND SCAM IS COMING
scenes.narration: Scammed once? The second scam is already coming.

scenes.head: THE TRICK
scenes.hook: FAKE EXPERTS PROMISE TO GET IT BACK
scenes.narration: Fake recovery services find past victims and promise to get the money back. Warnings from the FBI and the CFTC describe this pattern.

scenes.head: RED FLAG
scenes.narration: Red flags: they ask for a fee first, they guarantee results, and they contacted you without being asked.

scenes.head: THE FIX
scenes.narration: Do not pay anyone who messages you first. Report the loss to official agencies in your country instead.
